entries.headline: Five transports, command jet and coded broadcast reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported five US Air Force transport aircraft airborne over the continental United States alongside a nuclear command-and-control jet. It also reported one coded radio broadcast heard during that hour, without identifying its content or linking it to the flights.

entries.headline: War Watch shares report of hazard pay increases
entries.summary: War Watch Intel shared a Pentagon News report describing increases to two hazard pay allowances for the first time in nearly a quarter century, crediting @Hawkeye_CNY. The visible post did not give the allowance names, rates or effective dates.

entries.headline: War Watch shares report on jet-powered drones and interceptors
entries.summary: War Watch Intel shared an Associated Press report describing jet-powered drones outpacing Ukrainian defenses while manufacturers worked on new interceptors, crediting @hawkeye_cny. The post relays the report without providing an independent assessment of drone or interceptor performance.

entries.headline: US and Baltic transport activity and Alaska sighting reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported six US Air Force transport aircraft airborne over the United States and Baltic region, and a surveillance aircraft sighting near Alaska. It described activity as normal and reported no coded broadcasts during the preceding hour.

entries.headline: Six cargo aircraft and no coded alerts reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported six US Air Force cargo aircraft airborne, with three over the North Sea and three over the continental United States. It also reported an earlier surveillance aircraft sighting and no coded alerts during the preceding hour.

entries.headline: Elevated Black Sea air activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel described military air activity in the Black Sea region as nearly five times its normal level and reported multiple US military transport and surveillance aircraft airborne there. The post did not identify callsigns, routes or missions.

entries.headline: Baltic surveillance flight and transport activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported a US Air Force surveillance aircraft operating over the Baltic and multiple military transport aircraft airborne across Europe and North America. The visible post did not identify their callsigns, destinations or missions.

entries.headline: Six transports across North America and North Sea reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported six US Air Force transport aircraft airborne across North America and the North Sea, and a surveillance aircraft spotted over the continental United States earlier that day. The post did not identify the flights' missions.

entries.headline: Surveillance and transport aircraft activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported US Air Force surveillance and transport aircraft airborne over the North Sea and US territory. It also reported no unusual radio activity detected during the hour preceding the post.

entries.headline: Six transports and no coded broadcasts reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported six military transport aircraft airborne over the United States and North Sea, plus an earlier US Air Force surveillance aircraft sighting. It reported no coded radio broadcasts during the preceding hour.

entries.headline: North Sea transport flights and elevated Baltic activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported six US military transport aircraft airborne over the North Sea and United Kingdom, and described Baltic air activity as nearly 3.3 times normal levels. It also reported a Ukrainian drone attack into Russia underway at the time of the post, without detailing targets or outcomes.

entries.headline: Presidential aircraft and military transport activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported a presidential aircraft airborne over the United States, six military transport aircraft active over the North Sea and elsewhere, and a surveillance aircraft sighting. The visible post did not identify callsigns or destinations.

skyglass.caption: Military aircraft movement reports.

entries.headline: APACHE E3CF departure alert at Penaflor
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an OFF Ground alert for APACHE, an aircraft labeled E3CF, at Penaflor, Chile. The post described a UK-registered military E-3C warning and control aircraft but did not confirm the flight's destination or mission.

entries.headline: VVBH341 P-3 departure alert at Lexington Park
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an OFF Ground alert for VVBH341, a US-registered military P-3 Orion, at Lexington Park, Maryland. The post reported a departure without confirming its destination or mission.

entries.headline: New P-8 ground alert at Orange Park
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an ON Ground alert for a US-registered military P-8 Poseidon at Orange Park, Florida. This separately dated alert did not supply a callsign or confirm the reason for the aircraft's ground status.

entries.headline: P-8 departure alert at Burela de Cabo
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an OFF Ground alert for a US military P-8 at Burela de Cabo, Spain. Its callsign field contained placeholder characters; the post did not confirm the aircraft's destination or mission.

entries.headline: P8 departure alert at Masdar City
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an OFF Ground alert for a US-registered aircraft labeled P8 at Masdar City, United Arab Emirates. The post described the registration as commercial and suggested a P-8 Poseidon identification; its destination and mission were not confirmed.

entries.headline: P-3 departure alert at Kaohsiung
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an OFF Ground alert for a Taiwan-registered military P-3 Orion at Kaohsiung, Taiwan. The post reported a departure without confirming a callsign, destination or mission.

entries.headline: LOBO01 P-3 departure alert at Beja
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an OFF Ground alert for LOBO01, a Portuguese-registered military P-3, at Beja, Portugal. The post reported detection after takeoff but did not confirm its destination or mission.

entries.headline: E3TF ground alert at Midwest City
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an ON Ground alert for a US military aircraft labeled E3TF at Midwest City, Oklahoma. The post described an airborne warning and control aircraft but did not confirm the reason for its ground status.

entries.headline: SkyGlass shares report of Taiwan F-16 deliveries
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a Defence Blog report that Taiwan received the first two of 66 F-16V Block 70 fighters after a three-year delay. The post relays the delivery report rather than independently verifying the aircraft's arrival.

entries.headline: P-8 departure alert at Tada Khandrika
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an OFF Ground alert for an Indian-registered military P-8 Poseidon at Tada Khandrika, India. The post reported a departure without confirming its destination or mission.

entries.headline: P-3 departure alert at Magong
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an OFF Ground alert for a Taiwan-registered military P-3 Orion at Magong, Taiwan. The alert reported a departure but did not confirm the aircraft's destination or mission.

entries.headline: ASY169 P-8 ground alert at Kadena
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an ON Ground alert for ASY169, an Australian-registered military P-8 Poseidon, at Kadena, Japan. The post did not confirm the purpose of the stop.
